name: Rotation by Shearing
definition: A technique for rotating a point cloud by decomposing the rotation into a sequence of shear operations. It is described as an 'area-preserving discrete rotation' in 2D that does not introduce holes, but in 3D it requires chaining multiple shears.
summary: Rotation by shearing decomposes point cloud rotation into sequential shear operations, avoiding matrix inversion overhead but introducing rounding error artifacts.
